name: 3-MAL Secure Comlink
note: Comlink transmit up to medium range on the planetary scale. Encryption adds ⬛ to any check made to intercept and unscramble the signal. Monitoring a standard clear frequency on civilized worlds can add ⬛⬛ to Knowledge checks related to current events or conditions at the GM's discretion

name: Atgar Artillery Remote
note: A character can link a single Gunnery weapon to an Atgar Artillery Remote with a Hard(ddd) Computers check or a Average (dd) Computers check if the weapon is Atgar Spacedefense corporation model. Linked weapon gains the Inaccurate 2 quality and the holder of the remote can fire the weapon from up to medium range.

name: Collar-Amp
note: Allows users voice to be heard up to long or extreme range (dependant on terrain and other environmental conditions), add 100 credits for a version that hooks into sound systems or entertainment sound systems which improves sound quality

name: Comlink (Handheld)
note: Allows communication up to distances around 100 kilometres

name: Comlink (Long Range)
note: Allows communication across a planet, to orbiting structures, and possibly interplanetary (within the same star system)

name: DH77 Headcomm
note: Subject to interference from explosions, ion engines and jamming, constant shifting encryption adds ⬛⬛⬛ to any attempt to intercept and unscramble the signal

name: Encryption Module
note: Attaches to comlinks or hypertranscivers to encode messages sent, much larger and more sophisticated than a simple comm scrambler the encryption module uses extremely complex algorithms and ciphers to code transmissions. It is nearly impossible to break the codes used so it requires a decryption key to understand but attempts can still be made with a Formidable (ddddd) computers check and also requires proper equipment such as a ship's mainframe or a class one droid.

name: False Voice Transmitter
note: Provided a good voice sample, can replicate any voice. When impersonating another individual the user can upgrade the ability of his Charm, Coercion, Deception, Leadership and Negotiation checks once.

name: Shockhold Hardened Comlink
note: Planet-wide and planet to orbit communications with military grade encryption, adds an automatic ff to decode and a automatic ss to any checks made to broadcast through a com jammer (FaD:Knights of fate version says only one s and only one f)

name: Holo-Messenger
note: Used mostly for messages. Plays a holographic recording or transmission.

name: HoloNet Relay
note: Allows user to communicate with the HoloNet (it is highly regulated and mostly militarized by the empire though) can be blocked by jamming and/or environmental factors.

name: Hyper transceiver
note: Able to transmit up to 100 light years, normally used for ships sending messages or distress signals.

name: Intergraded Public Address System
note: Loudspeaker installed in a backpack or carrying case for addressing large crowds anywhere

name: PTP Link
note: Lower tech communication range of 25 kilometres. A encryption device can be purchased for 1,000 credits for near undetectable transmission of messages

name: Remote Activation Controller (Long range)
note: Activates a vehicle or starship and starts pre-flight checks so user can make a quick getaway

name: Remote Activation Controller (Short range)
note: Activates a vehicle or starship and starts pre-flight checks so user can make a quick getaway

name: Verpine Comlink
note: Picks up on Verpine telepathic communications and can broadcast secret messages using said link, range 100 kilometres.

name: Com-Scan
note: A character can Triangulate the location and movement of a known comlink or transceiver with an Average (dd) Computers check. The device functions out to close range on planetary scale. Prevailing atmospheric conditions or excessive background signals can reduce its efficacy.

name: Earbud Comlink
note: Activated by touching ones ear, or clicking ones teeth, This has a far shorter range than of a normal commlink due to tiny power cell and can only work to a maximum range of long, Noticing someone wearing a earbud comlink requires a Hard (ddd) Perception check.

name: Holo-Megacaster
note: Projects a large holographic version of the user up to 10 meters in height, normally used for addressing large crowds. A Character using a Holo-Megacaster adds to Presence-based checks to address a crowd and allows the users image and voice to be seen and heard clearly up to extreme range.

name: Antidote Set
note: When used reduce the difficulty of any check to resist a poison by two (to a minimum of Easy (d)), if character does not know what poison was used he/she must make a Hard (ddd) Knowledge (Underworld) check to make a educated guess on the poison to benefit from this item

name: Dendriton Toxin (1 dose)
note: Has a Daunting (dddd) difficulty, if the target fails the check the poison inflicts 1 strain at the end of his next turn, 3 strain at the end of the subsequent turn and 5 strain at the turn after that one (ignoring soak) in addition the target suffers ⬛ to any check he attempts under the effects of the poison, each t he generates on those checks inflicts 1 additional strain (ignores soak), The GM may spend y on the initial Resilience check to make the target make another check against the poison at the end of his third turn or suffer an additional 5 strain

name: Dioxis Gas (1 dose)
note: A single dose has a Hard (ddd) difficulty, 2 or more doses have a Daunting (dddd) difficulty, if the target fail the check the poison inflicts 5 wounds (ignoring soak) in addition each t generated inflicts 2 strain on the target (ignores soak), target becomes overwhelmed by nausea and muscle spasms cause by the choking gas. Gas lingers in the air for up to 3 rounds unless dissipated by high winds

name: Poisoner's Ring
note: As an action make a opposed Skulduggery check against any onlookers' Vigilance to deposit one dose of any GM approved poison to a targets meal of beverage without being noticed

name: Raquor Venom (1 dose)
note: Has a Daunting (dddd) difficulty, if the target fails the check the poison staggers the target for 2 rounds and for each t generated inflicts 2 strain on the target (ignores soak), GM may spend y to Immobilize the target for 2 rounds. Can be Liquid or Gas (gas reducing the difficulty by one)

name: Synthetic Anaesthetic (1 dose)
note: Used to render subject unconscious, a single dose has an Average (dd) difficulty check while two ore more doses have a Hard (ddd) difficulty check. The poison inflicts 5 strain if the target fails the check, if the check generates one or two t , the target must also give up his free manoeuvre during his next turn, if three or more t is generated he/she is staggered during his/her next turn, Finally the GM can spend y to make the target test against the poison again during the next round to see if the poison remains in the subjects system

name: Synthetic Neuropralytic (1 dose)
note: Immobilizes the target, any dosage size has a Hard (ddd) difficulty check, if the target fails the check they are immobilized for three rounds, in addition on each t generated 1 strain is inflicted on the target, the GM can spend y to make the target test against the poison again during the next round

name: Synthetic Neurotoxin (1 dose)
note: If the target fails a Average (dd) check for a single dose or a Hard (ddd) check for multiple doses, the target suffers 5 wounds, in addition for each t one strain is suffered, the GM may spend one y to have the target test against the poison during the next round.

name: SleepPack (1 Dose)
note: If target is aware and unwilling the wielder must make a Hard (ddd) Brawl or Melee combat check against the target instead of inflicting damage, if successful the target must immediately resist the effects of the medications that flood the system as a poison (with a Resilience check). Any sized dose has a Hard (ddd) difficulty and failure inflicts 10 strain.

name: Sulfer Inhaler (10 Doses)
note: Only effective for Devaronians. As a manoeuvre inhale a does of the drug, the character suffers 2 strain and adds ⬛ to any Brawn or Agility he makes until the end of the encounter. Additional doses inflict more strain but do not give additional bonuses. Unpleasant for non-Devaronians

name: Affide Crystal
note: (Suicide pill usually in a false tooth) This is a poison that requires a upgraded Daunting cddd Resilience check to overcome when ingested. The poison inflicts 10 wounds and a Critical Injury on a failed check. Each t generated adds +40 to the roll for the Critical Injury result. Gms may spend ttt or y to kill a target instantly, leaving no opportunity for resuscitation.

name: Cyanoxis D-570
note: Administered through food and/or drink, once ingested the poison usually takes about a week to kill. A character who has injested this can make a hard ddd resilience check to overcome. On a failed check, the poison inflicts 2 wounds and 2 strain immediately, plus 1 wound and 1 strain per day for ten days or until the target succumbs to death. Each t generated inflicts 1 additional strain per day. y can be spent to increase the number of days the poison stays in effect by one.

name: Skirtopanol
note: Requires a hard ddd Resilience check to overcome. On a failed check, the drug inflicts 5 strain and the difficulty of all checks the target makes to resist charm or coercion for the remainder of the encounter is upgraded once. In addition, each t generated on the original check inflicts 2 strain on the target. finally, the GM can spend y to make the target check against the drug again during the next round as it remains in their system.

name: Vutalamine
note: known as "Vue,"a single dose lasts 24 hours, during that time the character upgrades the ability of any checks made to resist stress or fear once. In addition the difficulty of ranged (light) and ranged (heavy) checks made at long or extreme range is reduced by one. at the GMs discretion, frequent use can lead to impaired judgement and memory loss, imposing a permanent ⬛ on Intellect and Cunning based checks

name: Cybernetic Arms (mod V and VI)
note: Mod V Cyberarms provide +1 Brawn, while Mod VI Cyberarms provide +1 Agility. If replacing both arms they must both be the same Mod and stat modifiers do not stack

name: Cybernetic Brain Implant
note: Provides +1 Intellect, Comes with Commlink and Computer access link

name: Cybernetic Eyes
note: Provides +1 Vigilance and Perception

name: Cybernetic Legs (Mod II and III)
note: Mod II Cyberlegs provide +1 Brawn and Mod III cyberlegs provide +1 agility. BOTH legs must be replaced to receive these benefits.

name: Cybernetic Weapon Implant
note: Houses a retractable light blaster pistol that cannot be dropped, removed or disarmed

name: Cyber scanner Limb
note: Medium range detection showing nearby motion, lifeforms, energy signatures and other common targets as desired

name: Immune Implant
note: Provides wearer +1 Resilience

name: Implant Armour
note: Provides +1 Soak

name: Prosthetic Replacement (Limb)
note: Replaces a lost limb

name: Prosthetic Replacement (Organ)
note: Replaces a lost organ

name: Neuro-Saav Cyborg/Droid Interface
note: Direct connection to a droids communication port. When hooked up to a hostile droid upgrade the ability of all its computer checks once when attempting to access information

name: Swift 78B Vessel Courier System
note: Used to transport sensitive data in a small dataport that is secured usually beneath the courier's hairline secured by synthflesh.

name: Appraiser's Eye
note: Adds an automatic a on negotiation and streetwise checks to buy or sell items

name: Cybernetic Cavity
note: Provides 1 rank of the Hidden Storage talent

name: Digital Lockpick
note: provides 1 rank of the Bypass Security talent

name: Adrenal Implant
note: Provides 1 rank of the Rapid Recover Talent

name: Cybernetic Reflexes
note: Provides 1 rank of the Rapid Reaction Talent

name: Cybernetic Respirator
note: Provides user the same benefits of a breath mask and respirator and adds 1 rank of the Blooded Talent

name: Gank Comm Implant
note: Inaudible communication with other units, can be subject to jamming

name: Implanted Cyberjack
note: once per check, a character with an implanted cyberjack may suffer 2 strain to decrease the difficulty of a Computers check to disable a security device or slice into a computers system by one.

name: Neuromachine Interface
note: Allows control of a vehicle by thought, vehicle must have a control device installed, pilot using this link may use his coordination skill in place of the pilot (Planetary/Space) skill

name: Q-22 Retinal Tracker
note: Provides an automatic a on gunnery and Ranged (Heavy) checks.

name: Repulsor Fist
note: Provides one rank in the Defensive Stance talent and counts as a Brawl weapon with a Damage of 8, Critical of 3, and the Concussive 1 and Slow-Firing 2 qualities, can only be used once every 3rd round otherwise the repulsor fist acts as a normal unarmed melee attack.

name: Biofeedback Regulator
note: Increases the characters cybernetic implant cap by two. Does not count to implant cap. Limit 1 Regulator per person. Droids unable to use

name: Escape Circuit
note: (Droids only) Resisting a restraining bolt now only requires a Easy (d) Discipline check instead of the normal difficulty. The droid may spend aa from a check made to resist a restraining bolt to overload the bold rendering it entirely useless

name: Networked Slicing uplink
note: (Droids only) Counts as a set of slicer gear. When droid is slicing or assisting with slicing tasks, add ⬛ to Computers check to identify the user slicer based on these activities, such as Trace user action.

name: Neural Recorder
note: Make a Easy (d)Discipline check to recall information gained while the recorder was running. Recorded data can be copied to a more common external storage device using a included connection port

name: Surge Override Switch
note: Once per encounter a character can make a Average (dd) Discipline check to reactivate any number of cybernetic implants that have been overloaded by Ion weapons. Each reactivated implant causes 2 strain to the user

name: Avionics Interface
note: Requires at least 1 rank in piloting (Planetary) and/or (Space) gains +1 rank to the appropriate piloting skill when flying a starship or airspeeder..

name: Cortex Bomb
note: Upon hearing, seeing or speaking a pre-determined code a person with a implanted cortex bomb will be killed, this does no damage to the surrounding area…. Anyone watch that movie "Scanners (1981)"

name: Cyber Disguise
note: Gives advantages of a disguise kit, also grants user two ranks in Indistinguishable. This can change general features like eye or hair colour and even skin colour (do the whole Michael Jackson thing) grow hair and/or beard, With the GMs permission one could even impersonate someone of another similar shaped species (human, chiss, pantoran) it cannot change physical attributes like number of arms, size, horns. To impersonate a specific person (provided they are of similar size and shape) one must make a thorough study of the subject then make a Hard (ddd) Deception check to set the disguise. Changing can take up to 1 to 3 rounds, the more detailed the disguise the longer it takes either minutes or hours.

name: Lockbreaker Hand
note: Provides a rank in Bypass Security Talent and adds ⬛ to Skulduggery and Computers checks made to defeat locks

name: Multi-Tool Hand
note: Provides all the benefits of a tool kit "Go go gadget screwdriver"

name: Pain Damper
note: Upgrade the ability of all checks made to resist pain or physical torture once.

name: Retinal Implant
note: With a few minutes of studying a retinal pattern and a Average(ddd) Perception check, Retinal implants can fool most retina scanners with an Easy (d) Cool Check, More advanced scanners can have a increased difficulty up to a maximum of Hard (ddd)

name: Vessel Implant
note: Subdermal data storage, with a fiber optic cable that can plug into nearly any datapad or computer, the implant is non networked and can not be sliced unless user is incapacitated of the implant is removed, Finding a vessel implant on a character requires a Daunting (dddd) Perception check

name: Vocal Emulator Implant
note: Changing or disguising a characters voice takes one round, to mimic the voice of a specific individual the user must make a intensive study of the subject by listening to recordings, hearing the individual deliver a long speech etc. and make a Hard (ddd) Deception Check to nail down the individuals voice, speech patterns and inotations.

name: Electrobinoculars
note: Long distance or Low light Perception checks to identify an object may remove ⬛ from the check

name: General Purpose Scanner
note: Detect motion up to long distance; life-forms, energy signals and other common targets up to extreme distance / Intercept comlink transmissions

name: Hand Scanner
note: Detect detailed information about target or surroundings such as poisons, weaknesses, etc. up to short distance.

name: Macrobionoculars
note: Magnify targets up to 10 km.

name: Scanner Goggles
note: "When worn, scanner goggles allow the wearer to see normally in dark conditions." Its suggested for balance to replace that to this "Remove ⬛ due to low or poor light."

name: Surveillance Tagger
note: Must be physically attached to target. Detect targets location, direction and rate of movement up to around 100 km

name: Authentication Tools
note: A character using Authentication tools adds ⬛⬛ to checks to determine if a document has been falsified

name: Concealed Recorder
note: Add ⬛⬛ To a character's Perception checks to find a concealed recorder on a person's body

name: Security Sweeper
note: Make a Average (dd) Computers check to detect an area for any espionage tools and its location, if well hidden make a opposed Mechanics skill of the one who placed the device

name: Combat Scanner
note: Allows user to see normally in dark conditions and can track motion, heat and metal, adds ⬛⬛ to any checks made to attempt to decode and understand transmissions from the combat scanner to other combat scanners (FaD:Knights of fate version says remove ⬛⬛ to checks due to darkness)

name: Demolitions Scanner
note: Allows user to detect concealed explosive devices and adds ⬛ to any checks to do so

name: Recon Remote
note: Remote droid used for Recon and surveillance, 20 kilometre range.

name: Long-Range Terrain Scanner
note: Requires a Average (dd) Computers check on the part of the operator. Maps produced add ⬛ to any survival check made to navigate using the map plus an automatic s for every two a gained on the computers check

name: Ground-Penetrating Sensor Pack
note: Used to find things underground

name: Life Form Scanner
note: Detects up to half a kilometre away for lifeforms, Requires either an Average (dd) Survival Check or a Hard (ddd) Education or computers check to ensure the device is properly calibrated

name: Hunting Goggles
note: Grant ⬛ to any Perception skill checks made to locate prey. Removes ⬛⬛ imposed due to concealment, darkness or fog and mist from all Ranged (Light) and (Heavy) checks

name: Forensic Kit
note: Adds an automatic s to all Perception checks made by the user to spot and gather evidence.

name: Holoscanner
note: Reduce the difficulty of Perception or Vigilance checks to discover concealed items on a person or in a container or vehicle by two, typically a scanner cannot scan an item or group of items with an encumbrance higher then its own

name: Hyperwave Signal Interceptor
note: Range of 10 light years, can pickup and receive hyper communications and detect the smallest fluctuations in hyperspace, skilled operators can track vessels through hyperspace, providing several minutes warning prior to a ship exiting or giving the user a fairly good idea of the general course and direction of a vessel in hyperspace.

name: Weapon Detection Goggles
note: Add ⬛⬛ To a character's Perception checks to find a concealed weapon on a person's body

name: PX-7 Heat Sensor
note: A PX 7 heat sensor adds ⬛⬛ to Perception checks to find heat-emitting objects within short range and adds ⬛ to Mechanics checks to remove Critical Hits from starships and Critical Injuries from droids.

name: Veridicator 200
note: A character wearing a Veridicator 200 adds ⬛⬛ to checks to discern whether another character is lying or omitting significant information and adds ⬛⬛ to checks to ascertain another character's mental state

name: Low Feedback Scanner
note: Detects radiation sources of silhouette of 1 or larger within a short range, life forms within medium range, power sources within long range and Comms signals within extreme range. Extend the range of detection by 1 range for every silhouette size by which the target's size exceeds silhouette 1.

name: SE-Vigilant Automated Sensor
note: 1.6 meter collapsible post with sensors, first detects audio and visual and once it senses something it triggers a second scan commences with infrared, electromagnetic and other forms of scanning and relays the data to the users datapad. Can be left to operate by itself for long periods of time due to use of a solar panel.

name: Infrabinoculars
note: A character using Infrabinoculars can see through up to two meters of wall, possibly allowing surveillance of a whole building at once. Walls made of dense materials or constructed to shield their interiors may impose one or more on Perception checks to see inside, at GM's discretion

name: Infrabinoculars (with Long-Range sensors)
note: A character using Infrabinoculars can see through up to two meters of wall, possibly allowing surveillance of a whole building at once. Walls made of dense materials or constructed to shield their interiors may impose one or more on Perception checks to see inside, at GM's discretion. Can also be switched to a long range view equivalent to that of electrobinoculars.

name: Microdroid Listener
note: Can follow a set of pre-programmed instructions from their owner, returning after a set period of time or upon detection of a specific keyword or audio cue. The microdroid does not broadcast their surveillance data and they can be quite difficult to detect until they return. Planting this device without being noticed requires an opposed Skulduggery vs Vigilance check, Once in place a character must make a Daunting (dddd) Vigilance check to locate it even when she is specifically searching for one. Has a self destruct mode in case of tampering.

name: TaggeCo Privacy 7 Audio Curtain
note: Device comprises of two matched rods, Users can plant the rods onto nearly any horizontal surface in order to create a sound-dampening field between them, multiple sets of rods can enclose a conversation or the user can place them at a physical gap such as an open door or the entry to an enclosed booth at a tapcafe. Characters attempting to listen in on a conversation which is being obscured by one or more audio curtains must make a Hard (ddd) Perception check to understand anything being said, The GM can spend t or y to have the character misunderstand key words or phrases

name: BioScan
note: Using a Bioscan to scan an area for life signs grants to any Perception checks opposing Stealth. Using the device to verify a person's identity requires an Average (dd) Computers check and a biometric identifier for comparison. The GM may modify this difficulty based upon any unusual anatomical characteristics of the target's species

name: HoloNet Homing Beacon
note: Can be attached to any ship, so long as the device is not noticed and removed or if the ship is traveling outside known systems the owner of the Homing Beacon can track the ship with no checks required.

name: Tracker's Goggles
note: Grant ⬛ to any Perception skill checks made to locate prey. Removes ⬛⬛ imposed due to concealment, darkness or fog and mist from all Ranged (Light) and (Heavy) checks

name: Applied Imaging B310 Micro-Imager
note: A Micro imager adds ⬛⬛ to any Perception, Knowledge (Lore) or Knowledge (Education) checks for which magnification of fine details can contribute to the research at hand.

name: Dalabar SDS-632 Surveillance Detector
note: A surveillance detector adds ⬛⬛ to any Perception of Vigilance checks to attempt to identify the presence of a bug within short range of the user

name: Fabritech 7000 Geoscanner
note: A Geoscanner adds ⬛ to any perception, lore or education checks related to studying the subterranean environment within medium range of the user

name: Paradour Enterprises Signature Scent Synthesizer
note: Using a signature scent synthesizer prior to a discussion removes ⬛⬛ from the first Charm, Coercion or Negotiations check made during the encounter.

name: SuriTech Foodstuffs Ez1 Analyser
note: Examines any food or drink to determine whether it is safe for consumption.

name: Mine Detector
note: Using a mine detector to locate concealed mines requires a Hard (ddd) Computers or Average (dd) Vigilance check with appropriate modifications for environmental conditions such as weather. flora, rough terrain, or the composition of the ground. On a successful check, all mines and other explosive devices within medium range are revealed to the user.

name: SE-90 Structural Engineering Scanner
note: Using an SE-90 requires an Average (dd) Computers check modified according to construction materials and environmental interference per the GM's discretion. A character who succeeds can see through walls or bulk heads up to short range until the end of the encounter or the scanner is moved.

name: Shipboard Systems Scanner
note: A shipboard system scanner removes ⬛ from checks to remove system strain from starships and vehicles.

name: Surveyor's Equipment
note: Surveyor's equipment adds ⬛⬛ to a character's Perception checks when determining locations on a planet's surface, measuring distances, plotting settlements or bases, and creating detailed planetary maps.

name: Surveillance Scanner
note: Used to check rooms for bugs or search for hidden observers or electronic surveillance, can detect and locate comms signals, electromagnetic fields, ect. Have a range of close on planetary scale or long on personal scale, using this scanner upgrades the ability of checks made to locate bugs, sweep rooms for hidden cameras, pick up data streams or engage in counter surveillance activities once.

name: Bacta (Litre)
note: For bacta tank. Replaces used bacta.

name: Bacta (Tank)
note: Recovers 1 wound per 2 hrs of use. If incapacitated 1 wound every 6 hrs| Every 24 hrs PCs can make resilience check to heal 1 crit injury

name: Emergency Medpac
note: Allows characters to use the Medicine skill to heal others without penalty (AoR:C pg 232/ EotE:C pg 219)

name: Medpac
note: In addition to effects of Emergency Medpack the Medpack grants ⬛ to all Medicine Skill Checks

name: Stimpack
note: Requires one manoeuvre to use on self or other, Immediately heals 5 wounds, a second stimpack heals 4 wounds, third 3 wounds and so on, six stimpacks in a single day has no effect

name: Synthskin/Sythflesh
note: (Unknown)

name: XV-38 Veterinary Kit
note: The PLAV allows a user to perform medical procedures on all manner of creatures much like a medpac for a humanoid, grants ⬛ to all medicine, survival and knowledge (Xenology) skill checks to analyse and/or treat these creatures

name: XV-09 Chemical Restraint Harness
note: Requires a Hard (ddd) Survival Check to fit a harness properly on a animal, this difficulty can be reduced by 1 with a successful Knowledge (Xenology) check. If successful, the XV-09 grants ⬛⬛ to any survival checks made to control a beast wearing the harness in addition, creatures that are successfully pacified gain ⬛ to any discipline checks. GMs can spend any t generated by the initial survival check to trigger side effects caused by drugs and are left to the GMs discretion, ttt or y can be used to reflect a catastrophic reaction

name: Cerebral Stabilizer
note: Apply to a patient within one round of suffering a critical injury, may be applied to a character suffering from a "Bleeding Out" or "The End is Nigh" critical injury or even a character who has died during the current round. Applying the device requires an Average (dd) Medicine check. Once applied the character is stabilized, if he died he is brought back to life and counts as suffering a gruesome injury (and all its effects) otherwise the critical injury effects are cancelled, though he suffers from the injury himself

name: Military Medpac
note: If user has no ranks in Medicine the user counts as having 1 rank in medicine when using this medpack, also removes medicine check penalty.

name: Medical Backpack
note: Allows characters to use the Medicine skill to heal others without penalty. Grants ⬛ to all Medicine checks made using Medical Backpack and decreases the difficulty of any Medicine checks to heal Critical Injuries by 1 to a minimum of Easy (d)

name: Blood Scanner
note: As an action. a character with a blood scanner may make an Easy (d) Medicine check to identify foreign elements (including poisons) in a blood sample. In addition to allowing the character to treat any present toxins with the proper antidote. The extensive information about the patient's health adds automatic aa to the next Medicine check the character makes to treat the patient.

name: Med-Aid Patch
note: When making a Medicine check to heal wounds from a character. A character can expend up to one med-aid patch to add automatic s+a to the results of the check. A character cannot use more than one med-aid patch per check.

name: Nullicaine
note: Character may apply Nullicaine to themselves or an engaged character by making an Easy (d) Medicine check and choosing 1 Easy (d), Average (dd) or Hard (ddd) Critical injury the target is currently suffering, if successful target suffers 3 strain and ignores the chosen critical injury until the end of the encounter

name: Stimstick
note: A character who chews a stimstick removes ⬛ from their discipline, Perception, Resilience or Vigilance checks to stay awake or notice something due to fatigue or lack of sleep until the end of the encounter, at the end of the encounter the character suffers 1 strain.

name: Military Traumapac
note: A traumapac only allows a character to use the Medicine skill to attempt to remove Critical Injuries from others without penalty.

name: Healer's Kit
note: Must be made by the character with a Hard (ddd) Survival check. Allows the character to use the medicine skill to heal themselves or others without penalty. GM may spend y on a Medicine check when a character is using a healer's kit to indicate that some or all of the medicinal items have been exhausted and the kit cannot be used again until restocked with a Average (dd) Survival Check.

name: XV-20 Portable Veterinary Kit
note: Allows an individual to treat a wounded or ill creature without penalty. Additionally the kit gains ⬛ to all medicine, survival and knowledge (xenology) skill checks made to diagnose or treat such animals

name: Antishock Blanket
note: When a character uses an antishock blanket to help heal a Critical Injury, the character may reduce the difficulty of the Medicine check made to heal the injury by one to a minimum of Easy (d).

name: Bioscan
note: A character using a bioscan can remove ⬛⬛ from any Medicine checks the character makes.

name: Plasma Protein Replicator
note: When a character uses a plasma protein replicator to help heal a Critical Injury, the character adds automatic s to the Medicine check made to heal the injury

name: Spray Plasto-Cast
note: A character can make an Easy (d) Medicine check to apply a spray plasto-cast to a limb that has been crippled or disabled due to a critical injury. If successful the critical injury heals automatically after one week of narrative time.

name: Toxin Detector
note: detects toxins and poisons in food, drink and even in the environment, Simple red/green indicators or subtle vibration to alert user to presence of dangerous substances, often built into bracelets or other jewellery for maximum subtlety.

name: "Knack" Restraining Bolt
note: Allows for secret commands to be sent or triggered on droids, PC droids can attempt to resist a "Knack" restraining bolt like a regular restraining bolt

name: Advanced Flesh Camouflage Kit
note: Drastically change appearance to a genetic level even fooling bioscanners, requires a Formidable (ddddd) Perception Check to see through it

name: AL-DR8 Grav-Binders
note: Breaking free from grav binders requires a Formidable (ddddd) Athletics check (due to the restrictive effects of the artificially raised gravity on the whole body, a character cannot slip free of gravbinders using flexibility alone).

name: Binders
note: Requires a Daunting (dddd) Athletics or Coordination check to escape

name: BlackOps/Outlaw Data Breaker
note: Add ⬛⬛ to any Computers check made to slice computers, add ⬛ to any attempts to locate use of a data breaker in a computer system due to " noise " (highly illegal)

name: Cargo Scanner
note: Make a Average (dd) Computers check to increase the available encumbrance capacity of a planetary vehicle or starship with a silhouette of 3 or my by 10 percent (rounding up) thanks to more efficient organization

name: Tear of the Elders
note: Once per game session, when a Force-sensitive character hold the Tear of the Elders, the character may make a force power check and spend 2 light or dark side power to detect one threat the PC is likely to encounter during the current game session. GM has final say on what the threat is and how the character perceives it, either clearly or metaphorical sense e.g. a battalion of storm troopers metaphorically could be a solid white wall that is impossible to penetrate.
category: Relics, Focuses, Fetishes, Holocrons and Ancient Talsimans

name: Dai Bendu Holocron
note: Took a few reads to understand but the basics of it is, need to be a force sensitive to use (don’t have to be strong in force to use it) GM decides how long this will take but should be a very long while for study, Select a characteristic, must complete 4 lessons by doing discipline checks with increasing difficulty from average dd to hard ddd to daunting dddd to formidable ddddd. Once all 4 lessons are complete in a characteristic (tract is what the book calls it) character may (once per day) upgrade the ability dice pool of any single check related to that characteristic by two steps. Player may once completed all 4 lessons in a characteristic may move onto another keeping the same benefit they have acquired
category: Relics, Focuses, Fetishes, Holocrons and Ancient Talsimans

name: Lasan Chronicles of the Three
note: Spend 1 hour and successfully pass a Hard (ddd) check with one of the following skills to receive a bonus that can be used once in your current session.
